entities.summary: The Bugatti Vision Gran Turismo is a single-seater concept car developed by Bugatti and was manufactured in Molsheim, Alsace, France. The car was unveiled at the 2015 Frankfurt Motor Show, a month after its teaser trailer was released, which was titled #imaginEBugatti. Built under the Vision Gran Turismo programme, the car's design is a precursor to the Bugatti Chiron, and also pays homage to the 1937 Le Mans-winning Bugatti Type 57G Tank racer, in which its livery is also based upon.
